name: Bench Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your legs extending past the end and grip the edges securely behind your head or hips.
Press your lower back into the bench and brace your abs tightly.
Lift both straight legs smoothly together until your feet rise directly above your hips.
Lower your legs slowly under control, stopping just before your lower back begins to arch off the pad.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your knees if straight legs pull your pelvis into an arch.
Start the lift without swinging your legs or tipping your pelvis forward.
